records.name: North Dakota Indian Affairs Commission
records.what: The state office that links North Dakota's governor and state agencies with the tribes in the state. Its website gathers links on tribal enrollment and other resources.
records.who: Tribes, Native people and anyone working with tribes in North Dakota.
records.start: Use the contact page on its website.
records.address: 600 E. Boulevard Ave., 1st Floor Judicial Wing, Rm. 117, Bismarck, ND 58505
